title: WADE TULIP TROUGH, BISCUIT BAR...
reason: Wade Heath marked tulip trough plus a plated blue jasper-style biscuit barrel that could be Wedgwood or Adams if marked underneath; decent mixed group of four.
findings: Four pieces. (1) Tulip trough in honey brown glaze with moulded tulips and green leaves; photo 3 shows the base printed in black WADE HEATH ENGLAND in the hand-lettered 1930s style, with fine glaze crazing and three small round pad marks, so the Wade attribution in the title is supported. (2) Dark blue jasper-dip style biscuit barrel with white sprigged classical figures (standing woman with two winged putti), plated rim, lid, knob and swing handle; no maker's mark visible and base not photographed, so Wedgwood, Adams or another maker cannot be confirmed (worth checking the base). (3) Cream stoneware stein with a blue crown over HB (Hofbrauhaus Munchen type monogram) and a pewter lid with thumb lift; no capacity or maker marks visible. (4) Green glazed bell-shaped posy holder with pierced top and moulded lettering around the shoulder reading DIGUE DIN DON repeated; maker not identified (web search found nothing).
condition: Trough looks sound with no chips or cracks seen, only fine crazing. Plated lid on the biscuit barrel is dulled and worn; jasper body looks undamaged. Stein shows some staining and pewter lid wear. Bell posy holder may have tiny nicks at the foot rim.
rescore_note: Wade Heath tulip trough is confirmed by the base mark seen in photo 3; the plated blue jasper-dip biscuit barrel could be Wedgwood or Adams but is unmarked in the photos, and the stein and bell posy holder are minor, so lower part of the $80 to 200 band. (no web price check)
